name: art deco style
notes: cubist angles per lang university; contrast fields (onyx/diamond, lacquer) and calibre settings are era markers in metal-only pieces; drift fix (2026-10-07): added sun_motif facet shared with celestial. louymagroos and awedeco both market this collection as literal sun jewelry ('art deco sun jewelry', 'the iconic sunburst motif'), not just an abstract geometric pattern, so the sunburst feature carries a real sun-imagery reading worth a shared facet, kept weaker than the dedicated sunburst/geometric_step features so art_deco's core identity stays geometric, not solar.

name: retro style
notes: weak evidence pass: only marketplace listings surfaced. features stay as-is and flagged; needs a dedicated retro (1940s-50s) dealer or scholarship source before enrichment weak-evidence flag lifted: lang university retro era page plus two dealer guides (robinsons, antique jewellery company) corroborate gold bows, scrolls, florals, three-dimensional goldwork and fabric motifs; drift fix (2026-10-07): added postwar_era axis shared with mid_century_modernist. versani and langantiques both place mid-century jewelry as the direct successor to the 1940s retro era ('the generation right after wwii'), a sourced timeline fact, not a vibe. kept weaker than the chunky axis so retro's identity stays bold/curved, not merely 'early mid-century'.

name: mid-century modernist style
notes: evidence pass surfaced marketplace listings only (pinterest, 1stdibs), which corroborate the abstract/geometric reading but are not guides; a modernist art-jewelry scholarship source is still needed weak-evidence flag lifted: element79 mid-century guide and scandinavian modern scholarship (skyjems, jensensilver, bard graduate center) corroborate sculptural abstract forms and the georg jensen/skonvirke lineage, which cross-links the art nouveau confusable chain; drift fix (2026-10-07): added postwar_era axis shared with retro, same sourced timeline fact (versani, langantiques: mid-century succeeds the 1940s retro era directly). kept weaker than modern/clean so mid-century's identity stays sculptural/abstract, not merely 'late retro'.

name: celestial style
notes: three dedicated guides (lindseyscoggins, linknecklaces, enroute) corroborate moon/star/sun motifs, crescents, and constellation dot patterns; spiritual/protection symbolism cross-links the symbol layer, never a claim; drift fix (2026-10-07): added sun_motif (shared with art_deco: literal sun charms vs. geometric sunburst are the same core motif at different stylization levels, per louymagroos/awedeco) and dark_celestial_motif (shared with gothic: 'celestial goth'/'witchy celestial' is a real sold crossover category per etsy and shieldmaidenjewelry, crescent moons rendered in oxidized dark metal). both kept secondary so celestial's dominant identity stays star/moon/sun, not deco or goth.

name: gothic style
notes: american gem society + bikerringshop guides corroborate crosses, daggers, skulls, chains, and the oxidized silver idiom; skull feature now shared with biker (confusable edge stands); drift fix (2026-10-07): added dark_celestial_motif facet shared with celestial, sourced from the 'celestial goth'/witchy jewelry crossover category (etsy, shieldmaidenjewelry): moon/crescent iconography rendered in gothic's oxidized dark finish. kept secondary; gothic's identity stays cross/dagger/skull, not lunar.
